approvedDeviations.reason: 实收金额 value uses fontWeight 900 (HarmonyOS Sans TC Black) in figma. The app ships only SpxBrand-Bold (700) bundled as the brand face — RN-Web clamps Black to 700. Visual difference imperceptible at 14px. Same 900→700 clamp documented in sgb-account fidelity 2026-05-28.
